name: blueprint/obsidian-vault
description: The agent-notebook pattern over a real Obsidian vault: scan markdown via rh_run, index into the store, recall by prefix, compact long notes
ingredients: rh_run file reads over the vault path
recipe: scan the vault via rh_run -> index titles and paths into the store -> recall by prefix scan -> compact long notes with the original kept
pitfalls: vault paths are local - receipts carry them
the index goes stale - rescan on change
compaction never replaces the source note
frontmatter and backlinks are markdown - parse, do not guess
